title: Incident
description: A single raw detection from one sensing source (IMU or camera). Fused into a Decision by /core.

id.description: UUID, set by whoever creates the incident. Optional but recommended for de-duplication during fusion.

car_id.description: Null for source-agnostic events like debris that aren't attributed to one car.

extra.description: Optional source-specific payload, e.g. {"g_force":8.2} for imu-origin or {"bbox":[x,y,w,h]} for camera-origin.
